title: Retain counted Balanced for Zstandard input
question: Can a second checked input decode avoid the decoded Dataset spool for native Balanced?
summary: Retain the opt-in native Zstandard input path. The measured Balanced job is 24.4% faster while CLI CPU rises 19.9%. Remove the independently rejected one-worker serial Sort guard.

workloads: 2 GiB decoded, varied checksummed Zstandard input, eight plain Balanced outputs, 1 GiB cgroup without swap, 256 MiB engine setting and one worker.

validation.summary: Exact fields, quotas, encounter order, digest, lineage, CSV byte caps and cleanup validated per job. Focused truncation, checksum rejection and prepared output comparison pass. Linux default and all-feature workspace tests and lint, WASI compile, native Windows focused contracts, and native default release restoration pass. WASI coverage is compile only for this source revision.

limitations: One synthetic varied input and three alternating pairs. WSL backing caches are uncontrolled.
Managed spool counters exclude physical I/O, input reads and final output bytes.
Recorded timings use the original selector expression. The later lint revision preserves its boolean behavior.
exclusions: Preflight, warmup, profiler run and initial fixture errors.
reopen_when: Require representative compressed inputs and platform transfer before considering broader activation.
